_partition._why: Declared as the map is authored, not assembled in a closing pass. 433-F accumulated 63 silently unreferenced fields precisely because that declaration was left to the end.
_partition._check: 103 + 0 + 0 = 103 bound writable, never-autofill and deferred, and that is every field page 1 draws. 447 - 103 = 344 unaccounted, which is every field on pages 2 to 6: 64 on page 2, 82 on page 3, 94 on page 4, 70 on page 5, 34 on page 6. THIS MAP IS NOT CLOSED and says so; the figure falls to zero when slice 4 lands and not before.
_partition._why_unaccounted_and_not_deferred: The two words are not synonyms in this engine. `deferred` is derived from fields the map NAMES under a `_deferred` key — an enumerated list of specific cells this slice declines to bind. `unaccounted` is derived from widget geometry over pages the map has not authored at all. Pages 2 to 6 are not a list of deferred cells; they are pages nobody has read yet, and calling them deferred would be a glob claiming the granularity of an enumeration.

_deferred_pages: Pages 2 and 3 are slice 2, 146 fields. Page 4 is slice 3, 94 fields. Pages 5 and 6 are slice 4, 104 fields. THE FIGURES ARE NOT PARENTHESISED, and that is not style: a bracketed number in map prose reads as a printed LINE MARKER to blanket-audit.mjs, which then demanded that marker from line-markers.mjs and reported a forward-reference gap, because this form draws no marker of that number. THIS SENTENCE ITSELF carried the bracketed figure in its first draft and reproduced the defect it describes — which is the fix reproducing the defect class it fixes, caught by the same audit on the next run.

_carried._why: The questions this form has raised that no slice has answered. An arguable item is reported in full, carries an id, and is not resolved.

open.subject: adapters/pdf/correlate-labels.mjs answers the caption ONE ROW ABOVE on this form, and its self-check refuses to write because of it
open.the_shape: Three pairings were established from the printed page and offered as probes. The tool answered the row above on all three, every time by a fraction of a point: p1_8_1c[0] — page says "County" (y 586.5, x 57.6..83.4, 3.6pt LEFT, baseline inside the rectangle), tool says "State" (y 597.3, 3.3pt ABOVE, x 180.0..198.8 overlapping); p1_15_2bc[0] — page says "Other LLC - Include number of members" (y 607.1, x 337.1..482.3, 7.3pt LEFT, baseline inside the rectangle), tool says "Limited Liability Company (LLC) classified as a corporation" (y 617.9, x 337.1..546.8, the row above, whose extra 64pt of width is the only reason it overlaps the cell at all); p1_42_7aAnnualSalDrw[3] — page says "Annual Salary/Draw" (y 53.7, x 367.2..437.6, 6.0pt LEFT), tool says "Ownership Percentage & Shares or Interest" (y 62.9, x 367.2..521.7, again the wider run one row up). In all three the correct caption IS in the tool's candidate list, ranked second.
open.the_cause: The ranking puts `above` and `left` on ONE distance scale, so a 3.3pt vertical gap beats a 3.6pt horizontal gap even though the vertical one crosses a printed row boundary. On 433-A, 433-F and 433-A(OIC) the dominant layout is caption-ABOVE-cell and the rule is right. 433-B's Sections 1 and 2 are caption-LEFT-of-cell in a two-column grid, and there it inverts.
open.why_it_is_not_settled_here: Retuning the probes until three cells are found where the tool happens to agree would be fitting the guard to the tool, and the guard exists to catch the tool. Changing the ranking is a change to a tool the other four forms depend on and needs its own regression across all four; it is not made during an intake. The consequence for now is stated rather than worked around: no labels file exists for 433-B and none of this form's bindings may cite one.

_the_condition_that_governs_page_1: Page 1 asks WHO THE BUSINESS IS and WHO SPEAKS FOR IT. Section 1 is the entity's own identity, contact and payroll facts; Section 2 is the natural persons behind it, each row carrying that person's relationship TO the entity — a title, an ownership percentage, a salary the entity pays, and whether they deposit its payroll taxes. NOTHING ON THIS PAGE IS AN ASSET, A LIABILITY OR AN AMOUNT THE FORM ADDS UP.
_no_arithmetic_on_this_page_at_all: CHECKED AGAINST THE DRAWN PAGE, not against the map. Page 1 draws no lettered Box, no "Total" line, no "Add lines", no "Subtract", no "minus" and no "multiply". So this slice declares no `_computed`, no `totals`, no `rounding` and no operand list — there is none to quote. _never_autofill._why: Nothing on page 1 is withheld. Every one of the 103 cells is a fact a filer supplies and none is a signature, a date of signature, or an IRS-use cell. The signature block and the "IRS USE ONLY" box are both on page 6.

_arguable_page1.what: Both cells of the 1d business telephone, and all 16 Section 2 phone cells, are bound on PRINTED PARENTHESES rather than on a caption.
_arguable_page1.the_reading: Each telephone is drawn as two cells under one caption, and the caption sits 14.7pt from the first cell and 48.2pt from the second. Nothing in the caption distinguishes them. The page draws "(" and ")" around the first cell every time — ten times on this page — and that is what the binding rests on.
_arguable_page1.why_it_is_arguable: A parenthesis is punctuation, and this engine's own correlators discard punctuation as non-descriptive before ranking. So the witness these ten cells stand on is one every other tool in the repo is built to throw away. It is the right witness here because it is the only thing on the page that separates the two cells, but it is a witness of a kind nothing else in this engine uses, and if it were ever wrong nothing else would contradict it.
_arguable_page1.what_would_settle_it: A round trip: fill the area-code cell with a value that cannot be a subscriber number and read the filled page back. Not done in this slice.

_arguable_page1.what: The two page-1 tables are bound on COLUMN HEADERS, which is a weaker witness than a per-cell caption.
_arguable_page1.the_reading: Table_Line5a-b and Table_Lines6a-c print no caption beside any cell. The only printed text naming a column is the header above the whole table, and the row comes from the printed marker. Every one of those 16 cells is bound on header x-range containment plus marker row.
_arguable_page1.why_it_is_arguable: Header containment is a claim about a COLUMN and the cell inherits it. Where two cells share a column — the credit-card bank address and its phone — containment alone binds both to the same header, and only the printed "Phone" on the lower band separates them. That second witness exists for the phone cell; the bank cell is bound by being the one that is left.
_arguable_page1.what_would_settle_it: The same round trip. A filled copy would show a bank address in the phone row immediately.

_arguable_page1.what: The 2b entity set is declared exclusive on the printed instruction, not on anything the PDF enforces.
_arguable_page1.the_reading: "(Check appropriate box below)" at y 639.5, x 374.8..484.0 is singular. The five boxes are five separate checkbox fields with five different on-states, not one radio group — nothing in the AcroForm prevents two being ticked at once.
_arguable_page1.why_it_is_arguable: The exclusivity is a reading of the printed instruction. "appropriate box" is singular but the form also prints "Other" and "Other LLC - Include number of members" as separate options, and an LLC classified as a corporation arguably satisfies two of the five descriptions at once. The map declares one; the page does not enforce it.
_arguable_page1.what_would_settle_it: Nothing on page 1. It is a question about what the IRS accepts, not about what the page draws.

_arguable_page1.what: The four Section 2 rows are modelled as a group with max 4 and no printed overflow instruction.
_arguable_page1.the_reading: The page draws exactly four personnel rows and the masthead says "Include attachments if additional space is needed to respond completely to any question." (y 679.3, x 230.4..570.3). That sentence is the form's only statement about what happens past the printed rows, and it is printed once for the whole form rather than beside this block.
_arguable_page1.why_it_is_arguable: Every other overflow declaration in this engine cites a per-block printed instruction. Here there is none, so a fifth partner has nowhere to go and the general attachment sentence is doing the work of a block-level one. Whether that sentence licenses an overflow declaration for THIS block is a reading.
_arguable_page1.what_would_settle_it: It is a genuine gap in what the page says. Recorded, not resolved.
